instruction: Candid documentary photograph, medium shot. Inside an unfinished concrete building, the woman in the yellow safety vest and yellow hard hat (R2) stands on the left in profile, facing right. On the right, the woman in the orange safety vest and white hard hat (R1) stands in profile, facing left. They are captured mid-handshake, gripping each other's right hands with a slightly adjusted hold. They look at each other with friendly expressions. The background shows a textured concrete wall and a glass door frame. Soft, natural lighting illuminates the subjects and their colorful safety vests.
